## Problem

What are you trying to do with a workbook that Ironsheet cannot do today?

## Proposed solution

The API or behavior you would like to see. Ironsheet favors narrow, preservation-safe mutations over broad write features, so describe the smallest capability that solves your problem.

## Workbook context

Which workbook features are involved (tables, pivots, charts, macros, styles, defined names, ...)? If possible, attach a sample workbook that shows the structure you need to edit.

## Alternatives considered

Workarounds you tried (other libraries, manual XML edits, template changes) and why they fall short.
